verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a built-in rate limiter meant to prevent abuse, with configurable window/max settings, IP-header configuration, and a stricter default rule on /sign-in/email (3 requests per 10 seconds). Together with default scrypt password hashing, this gives real first-party brute-force protection, and a community user confirms rate limiting comes built in. Missing for 10: any evidence of bot protection (CAPTCHA or bot detection), credential-stuffing defenses such as breached-password checks or account lockout, and independent hands-on validation that the protections hold up under attack.
